findings.summary: Nonidentical variants persist the representative artifact's witnesses instead of their own artifact-local proofs
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index.ml:1880-1902 selects target_witness_jobs belonging to source_artifact and stores those unchanged witness fields under the current artifact. lib/arch_index/arch_index_cmt.ml:3522-3530 hashes declaration/formal Ident.unique_name keys but not local_module_invocation_member results.
findings.fix: Collect correspondence proofs independently before graph reuse, uniquely reconcile stable physical occurrence fields, and persist only the current artifact's proof.

findings.summary: Stale frozen or corpus inputs are classified as assertion failures instead of setup failures
findings.evidence: roster/ocaml-functor-targets/check-tezos.js:120-128 and :214-215 use assert.equal for frozen hashes, snapshot and Tezos revision; the final handler maps every AssertionError to exit 1 although FR-031/FR-036 require setup exit at least 2.
findings.fix: Use SetupError for frozen/current input integrity checks, reserve assertion exit 1 for semantic mismatches, and add stale-input controls.

findings.summary: Three required standalone binding gates bypass the selected opam environment and fail as documented
findings.evidence: briefs/ocaml-functor-targets-qa-scope.md:20-23 produced inventory exit 1, lifecycle exit 2 and compatibility exit 1; the equivalent opam exec -- node invocations and CHECK-2 exited 0.
findings.fix: Run all four modes through opam exec -- node and rerun the exact documented gates.

findings.summary: The normal CHECK-1/2/3 commands do not exercise their advertised exit-code controls
findings.evidence: briefs/ocaml-functor-targets-qa-scope.md:11 advertises pass/assertion/setup controls, but the listed gates never supply the --test-control arguments implemented by the three checkers.
findings.fix: Add explicit 0/1/2 invocations for all three checkers to the QA scope.

findings.summary: Three documented standalone binding gates fail outside OPAM despite being required as validated non-degraded gates
findings.evidence: briefs/ocaml-functor-targets-qa-scope.md:20-23 documents direct rtk proxy node invocations. Observed exits were inventory=1, lifecycle=1, query=0 and compatibility=1; CHECK-2 masks the issue by using opam exec.
findings.fix: Change the documented commands to opam exec -- node and rerun them.

findings.summary: Physical occurrence identity is stored but never authenticated
findings.evidence: architecture-schema.sql:154 stores occurrence_ordinal standalone; calls has no discriminator and lib/arch_index/arch_index_bindings.ml:799 validates only caller plus file:start_line, so a nonexistent or swapped same-line ordinal can finalize.
findings.fix: Persist a keyed physical occurrence inventory, foreign-key witnesses and candidates to it, and add same-line corruption and ambiguity tests.

findings.summary: The actual/member-to-target witness chain is not authenticated
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_bindings.ml:799-811 checks only nonempty path JSON and source-module ownership; it never proves that resolving that actual member yields target_function_id.
findings.fix: Persist an exact resolved-member identity through keyed occurrence/candidate links and add member-path and target-swap corruption tests.

findings.summary: Nonidentical variants borrow representative proofs instead of reconciling artifact-local proofs
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_cmt.ml:3659-3674 returns before variant targets are collected; lib/arch_index/arch_index.ml:1880-1902 copies representative witnesses under the variant artifact without zero/one/multiple stable-field reconciliation.
findings.fix: Collect each variant's local proof before reuse and attach it only after one stable representative occurrence and target match.

findings.summary: Target-storage failures do not preserve the required failed-input lifecycle
findings.evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index.ml:1901-1909 commits candidate calls before witness storage; failure only logs and disables finalization, records no collection_failed input, and leaves an unwitnessed positive call usable.
findings.fix: Make candidate and witness persistence atomic or quarantine rejected candidates, always record collection_failed, and add injected storage-failure tests.

findings.summary: Required binding, member, and reconciliation refusal counters are absent
findings.evidence: roster/ocaml-functor-targets/check-cmt.js:82 emits only a generic pass marker; neither producer nor checker reports distinct deterministic refusal categories required by FR-026.
findings.fix: Persist refusal categories, emit exact sorted aggregates, and assert order-invariant counts.

findings.summary: CHECK-1 omits required arch-query and ambiguous-reconciliation verification
findings.evidence: roster/ocaml-functor-targets/check-cmt.js:45-82 builds arch-query but never invokes it for Stage-4 targets; its fixtures omit zero/multiple representative matches and default control execution.
findings.fix: Add target-aware arch-query assertions, absent/ambiguous variant fixtures, and explicit three-mode controls in QA.
